before.test/checkout_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule CheckoutTest do
  use ExUnit.Case
  test "submits the charge" do
    gateway = fn id -> send(self(), {:charge, id}); :ok end
    assert Checkout.pay("order-1", gateway) == :ok
    assert_received {:charge, "order-1"}
  end
end

after.test/checkout_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule CheckoutTest do
  use ExUnit.Case
  test "submits exactly one charge" do
    gateway = fn id -> send(self(), {:charge, id}); :ok end
    assert Checkout.pay("order-1", gateway) == :ok
    assert_received {:charge, "order-1"}
    refute_received {:charge, _}
  end
end
